description: A byte-identical scratch copy of the module version the pinned gateway go.mod requires, in which only two operands of the production RTU read change: the physical OpenRTUSerial(config.Serial) call becomes a call that returns the scripted RTUByteStream the replay executable installs, and the receipt wall-clock sample becomes the deterministic clock of the session. Nothing else in the module changes; the hooks are added in a separate file and default to the original calls.
